title: ambi_rot
description: `ambi_rot` calculates higher-order ambisonic rotation matrices, supporting 2D orders up to 12 and 3D orders up to 4. Its creation argument sets the ambisonic order; send a rotation angle in degrees for 2D, or a three-float list ordered z, y, x for 3D, and each outlet emits a `matrix` message for its corresponding order.
